failure_summary.description: Agents omitted pending work or active earlier-turn constraints, or performed unnecessary operations instead of reconciling each domain against the cache.
Agents nested cache retrievals or left result-producing calls unassigned or unsaved.
Agents added unrequested searches, duplicated attraction work, or inferred criteria not supported by the request.

patch.reasoning: The skill already contains broad cache and tool-call rules, but failures show agents are not consistently tracking all active criteria and pending deliverables across turns. A domain-by-domain ledger makes that reconciliation explicit, while clarifying that filters must cover every active criterion missing from the cached result—not only the latest turn’s additions.

edits.target: On each turn, reconcile the full conversation and cache, including explicitly requested tasks still pending from earlier turns, then decide separately for every requested or clearly pending domain.
edits.content: On each turn, make a domain-by-domain ledger from the full conversation and cache: include every requested, accepted, or pending deliverable and all still-active explicit criteria from every turn. Compare each criterion with the latest relevant cache summary, marking it satisfied, missing from the result, or blocked by a required input. Complete every actionable missing operation; seek information only for blocked operations, without letting one blocked domain prevent work on another. Do not add unrequested domains.

edits.target: Apply only the new same-domain filter and save the update under a fresh relevant key.
edits.content: Apply one same-domain filter containing all active explicit criteria missing from the chosen cached base, including criteria stated in earlier turns—not just the latest additions—and save the update under a fresh relevant key.
